snippet.title: OverBooked - Gameplay Trailer | Hotel Management Roguelike Deckbuilder
snippet.description:
Manage a hotel where EVERYTHING is a card! 🏨🃏 
OverBooked perfectly blends spatial planning with rogue-like deckbuilding. Play as a hardworking red panda receptionist, master crazy card synergies, optimize room layouts, and survive the relentless performance reviews (KPIs) from your lazy Panda Manager!

Can you handle 200+ eccentric animal guests, dynamic stat mutations, and secret synergy chains before your boss fires you? 

Stay tuned for more updates! Don't forget to LIKE, COMMENT, and SUBSCRIBE to support an indie dev!
